Brand Introduction:


BitBoy Games is redefining the future of gaming by blending retro console nostalgia with real crypto utility. Our mission? To empower gamers, creators, and crypto-curious users to play, earn, and engage with Web3—all from the palm of their hands. With a vibrant community and a creator-first culture, BitBoy is more than a device—it’s a movement.


Product Description:


The BitBoy One is a high-performance retro handheld gaming console with built-in Bitcoin mining, wallet integrations, and airdrop-earning capabilities. Pre-loaded with retro games, open source games, and emulators, it offers 8+ hours of gameplay, point-based rewards, and plug-and-play setup via SD card. It’s the first crypto-native gaming device that pays you back for playing.


USPs (Unique Selling Points):


- Crypto + Retro: First-of-its-kind device merging Web3 utility with retro gaming.
- Play-to-Earn IRL: Earn points and qualify for airdrops just by playing.
- Built-in Mining & Wallets: Users mine crypto and manage assets directly on-device.
- Premium Build: IPS display, fast ARM processor, 4GB RAM—engineered for smooth emulation.
Community-Driven: Leaderboards, Discord, giveaways, and more.


Payment Terms:


- Earn up to 30% commission per sale. Once tarrifs go away, this will increase!
- Payouts made monthly via PayPal or bank transfer
- Affiliate dashboard to track performance in real-time
- Top sellers unlock Premium Partner status with free gear, exclusive drops & more


Other Information:


- Creators of all sizes are welcome—from Twitter/X personalities to YouTubers, TikTokers, Discord mods, and newsletter curators.
- You'll get access to branded content kits, gameplay footage, ads, templates, and promo ideas.
- Leaderboards and seasonal contests keep things competitive (and rewarding).
- Early adopters have a real shot at becoming the face of BitBoy's next wave.


Ready to level up? Join BitBoy Games’ affiliate program and earn big while promoting a product that your audience will love. Whether you’re in it for the tech, the tokens, or the nostalgia—we’ve got a controller with your name on it.
